title: The Calculator before Maths
story: The maths test started after break. Farah had left her calculator in her locker. She put her hand up and told the teacher. The teacher could not stop the test, but a spare calculator was in the cupboard. Farah had to sign a card before she took it. She checked the buttons and then began. One question needed a long sum, and the spare machine showed the same result twice. Farah wrote the answer and showed her working too. When the test ended she returned the calculator and the card. The teacher thanked her for asking early. Farah put a spare of her own on the desk at home.
